**Pick Rossi Idraulica: 3,950 EUR all-in, 10 year warranty, two weeks.**

- Rossi Idraulica: Vaillant ecoTEC plus 30 kW, 3,950 EUR incl. VAT, old unit removed, ten year warranty (yearly service required, which Marta already does each November), fits in two weeks.
- TermoCasa: Baxi Duo-tec 28 kW, 4,148 EUR incl. VAT, five year warranty, fits next week. Removal not mentioned, so a possible extra charge.

Rossi is 198 EUR cheaper, twice the warranty, same brand as your current boiler, and Marta is your existing service contact. TermoCasa only wins by one week.

One flag before you commit: Marta suspects the pressure drop is the expansion vessel, which is a repair, not a reason to scrap a 2019 Vaillant. Worth checking with her at the 2026-11-14 service.
